priorityList: Enter Cat Form and Prowl before engaging in combat.
Use Tiger's Fury on cooldown, especially when energy is low or to align with Berserk/Incarnation.
Cast Chomp whenever the Chomp Enabler buff is active.
Use Ferocious Bite immediately if Apex Predator's Craving procs.
Activate Berserk or Incarnation while Tiger's Fury is active.
Use Frantic Frenzy when Tiger's Fury is active and you have 2 or fewer Combo Points.
Cast Convoke the Spirits while Berserk and Tiger's Fury are active, ideally after using a finisher.
Use Primal Wrath at 5 Combo Points to apply or refresh its bleed (refresh when under 6.5 seconds).
Use Ravage (Ferocious Bite) at 4+ Combo Points if the proc is active and Primal Wrath bleeds do not need refreshing.
In AoE, use Ferocious Bite at 5 Combo Points if talented into Rampant Ferocity and bleeds are already applied.
Maintain Rake on up to 5 targets (depending on talents) to maximize bleed coverage.
Maintain Moonfire on targets if the talent is active.
Use Swipe as your primary builder when 3 or more targets are present or while Berserk is active.
Use Shred as a builder only on 2 targets when at 1 or fewer Combo Points and talented into Panther's Guile.
Cast Regrowth with Predatory Swiftness procs if needed for survival or to reset timers.
